newsitem.title: USA: NY/NJ Port Authority approves JFK fuel farm road.
newsitem.headline: NY/NJ Port Authority approves JFK fuel farm road.

text.p: The Port Authority of Newark and New Jersey Port Authority said it approved a $23 million project for construction of a restricted service road from JFK's fuel farm to its north cargo area.

The agency said the road will serve many of the airport's slow moving and oversize aviation fuel trucks and aircraft service vehicles. It will include a bridge over the on-airport portion of the Van Wyck Expressway.
Construction of the new service road is expected to begin next autumn and be completed in the summer of 1999. -- Reuters Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+44 171 542 8982 Fax 5017
